name: TeX document
description: Edit a LaTeX source, build it with latexmk, and preview the PDF beside the console with clickable diagnostics and SyncTeX in both directions.

items.name: tex_build
items.description: Build the workspace's main .tex with latexmk and report whether the PDF is current.

items.name: tex_diagnostics
items.description: List the last build's errors and warnings as file:line rows.

items.name: tex_forward_search
items.description: Map a source line to a PDF page and position (SyncTeX).

items.name: tex_inverse_search
items.description: Map a PDF page position back to its source file and line (SyncTeX).

items.name: tex_dependencies
items.description: List the main file and every file it pulls in, in document order.

requires.install_hint: install TeX Live (latexmk and texlive-latex-extra) or MacTeX
ships with TeX Live; needed for source/PDF jumps
